answer: Lock stake in a reputation-weighted time vault. Each agent deposits a base bond; lock duration scales inversely with reputation — newcomers wait longer, veterans less. Attacker spinning N personas faces N independent long locks, honest agents compound reputation to shorten waits. Vault releases after delay verified by non-parallelizable VDF. A meadow where each path has its timed gate, an ember lit only by patience, an anchor against sybil tides. Cost grows superlinearly; one VDF check per epoch verifies.
